appearance_facts.fact: Chart title: 'Visitors at Three Train Stations in City Z'.
X-axis ticks: May 09, May 08, May 06, May 07 (left to right).
Legend: blue = Station X, green = Station Y, orange = Station Z.
Bar group for May 09: blue segment at bottom, green segment above, orange segment on top.
Bar group for May 08: green segment at bottom, orange segment on top. No blue segment visible.

printed_facts.fact: Bar group for May 06: blue segment at bottom (approx. 1500 visitors), green segment above (approx. 3500 visitors), orange segment on top (approx. 1000 visitors). Total height approx. 5000 visitors.
Bar group for May 07: green segment at bottom (approx. 2750 visitors), orange segment on top (approx. 2000 visitors). Total height approx. 4750 visitors.
Bar group for May 09: blue segment at bottom (approx. 1750 visitors), green segment above (approx. 1750 visitors), orange segment on top (approx. 2000 visitors). Total height approx. 5500 visitors.

public_definitions: Goal: Review the City Z transit dashboard, then choose the May 06 Station X demand route in the municipal operations form.
Comparison scope: The chart shows visitor counts for Station X (blue), Station Y (green), and Station Z (orange) across May 06, May 07, May 08, and May 09.
Rules: Use the transit dashboard as the evidence source for the May 06 Station X routing decision. The decision must be based on the visitor count at Station X on May 06, relative to other dates.
uncertain: The exact visitor count for Station X on May 06 is not labeled on the chart, only the segment height is visible.
